metrics.name: valid_json_rate
metrics.definition: Share of outputs that parse as JSON and validate against output_schema.json.

metrics.name: hypothesis_accuracy
metrics.definition: Share of (document, hypothesis) labels that exactly match the gold choice; invalid outputs count as wrong.

metrics.name: document_exact_match
metrics.definition: Share of documents with all 17 labels correct.

metrics.name: macro_f1
metrics.definition: Unweighted mean F1 over Entailment, Contradiction and NotMentioned across all pairs.

metrics.name: per_hypothesis_accuracy
metrics.definition: hypothesis_accuracy computed separately for each of the 17 ids.

aggregation.notes: Several hypotheses have no Contradiction examples in TEST (nda-8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 18); per-class F1 is undefined there and is reported as such.

exclusions: No partial credit for evidence or wording.
